title: Folk Hero
html:
Folk Hero is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around rescuing others from peril. Wyll, Minsc, and the hireling Danton have this background.

“
You're a champion of the common people, challenging tyrants and monsters to protect the helpless. Saving innocents in imminent danger will make your legend grow.
„

Background features

  • Animal Handling Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Wisdom (Animal Handling) Ability Checks.
  • Survival Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Wisdom (Survival) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
Act 1
Blighted Village 25 The Most Unfortunate Gnome Rescue the gnome from his fate at the windmill. This is earned after speaking to him.
Campsite 25 The Bard with Nine Lives Rescue Volo from the Goblin Camp.
  • The inspiration is granted in the camp, if Volo was sent there after saving him.
Emerald Grove 20 A Timely Rescue Save Findal from the goblins who kidnapped him.
20 Guardian of the Forgotten Save the tieflings from the goblin assault.
  • The party must defend the grove when Minthara's forces assault the grove.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Slaughter's Prize and ⁠A Headless Horde.
20 Protector of the Small Save Mirkon from the harpies.
  • Shared with ⁠The Allure of Coin and ⁠Slaying the Piper.
20 Snake Whisperer Save Arabella from Kagha and her serpent.
  • The party must complete the quest by speaking to Arabella and her parents to get the inspiration
Grymforge 30 Breaker of Chains Save the deep gnomes from Nere and the duergar.
Overgrown Tunnel 30 Unmasking the Truth Free the Mask of Regret, one of the Hag's masked thralls
Shattered Sanctum 25 Fate Worse Than Death Save Liam from his goblin torturers.
25 Saved by a Thread Save Smythin from his lethal fall.
  • There is a very tight timing as he is pushed down shortly after any party member reaches the top of stairs X: 305 Y: 0 or X: 288 Y: 0.
  • If Sazza is escorted out the grove before the party reaches this point, Smythin does not appear.
Underdark 30 A Lethal Endeavour Escort Baelen out of the field of bibberbangs.
Waukeen's Rest 30 Rescued from the Flames Save whoever you can from Waukeen's Rest.
  • Despite the description, saving either Florrick or Benryn grants it, even if the other one is still alive and blocked inside.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Damsel No More Free Nightsong.
Last Light Inn 50 A Smile Better Suits... Offer a hopeful response to Alfira's inquiry.
50 From One Hero to Another Meet Jaheira and drink the wine she offers.
50 Helping the Little Guy Help Mol win the game of lanceboard.
60 Meeting of Fates Side with either Isobel or Marcus during the confrontation in Last Light.
Moonrise Towers 50 No Strings to Hold Them Back Release the gnolls from their enslavement.
50 Uncommon Recognition Relate your feats to the bugbear merchant.
Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Breakout! Break out and save all of the Moonrise prisoners.
Reithwin Town 60 Power Corrupts Defeat a major figure in the corrupted town.
  • The party must defeat Gerringothe Thorm, Malus Thorm, or Thisobald Thorm.
75 Power Corrupts... Absolutely Defeat all of the major figures in the corrupted town.
  • The party must defeat Gerringothe Thorm, Malus Thorm, and Thisobald Thorm. All three must be defeated in combat.
50 Saving the Prodigious Save Rolan from the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 60 Greatness Thrust Upon Them Find, save & bring Arabella to your camp.
50 Not Another Soul Keep all Harpers alive during the ambush with the Shadows.
Act 3
House of Hope 220 Freeing the Preyed Free Hope from captivity.
Iron Throne 220 Against All Odds Rescue all thirteen captured Gondians' family members before the turn limit expires.
Lower City 170 A Bet Is a Bet Meet with Lakrissa in Baldur's Gate.
  • Only obtained if the party talked with Lakrissa in the Emerald Grove and made a wager with her on reaching Baldur's Gate.
170 Empathy for the Fallen Convince the coffin-maker Ulkov Sully to make an exception.
220 In Need of a Hero Successfully rescue all of the Gondians from the Steel Watch Foundry.
170 Painted Hero Obtain your portrait from Oskar.
170 Safeguarding the Songbird Meet the unflappable Alfira in Baldur's Gate.
170 Truth Shines Through Find the true culprit behind the serial murders.
Murder Tribunal 220 End of the Tribunal Save Valeria and end the Murder Tribunal.
Rivington 170 Innocence Lost Expose the toy-maker's mischief.
135 Keeping Your Hands Clean Refuse to cause collateral damage with Wulbren's plan.
135 Securing Hospitality Save the squatters from being kicked out.
135 Trusting Your Instincts Take up Valeria's shoddily concluded investigation.
Upper City 220 Chained, Unfortunate Souls Rescue the vampire spawn from Cazador's lair.
220 Never To Be Chained Again Defeat Lorroakan and let Nightsong execute her vengeance.
Wyrm's Rock Prison 170 Diplomatic Rescue Save Counsellor Florrick from Wyrm's Rock.
Wyrmway 170 Wyrmslayers Challenge and defeat Ansur, the not-so-immortal sentinel of Wyrm's Crossing.

Cut Background Goals

Soul Warden: Save Nadira from the bugbear assassin.

  • While this event is still present in the game, completing it does not seem to award this inspiration.

Liberator: Liberate the enthralled fishermen from the mindflaye

  • The enthralled fishermen were a group encountered in the crashed Mindflayer ship during early access but were removed for the release version, making this goal unobtainable.
